title: Traceable AMap POI and route request
prompt: Resolve a city-scoped POI and verify the walking leg to the next stop without exposing the Web service key.
commands: node skills/amap-travel-routing/scripts/query.mjs poi --keywords 三坊七巷 --city 福州 --city-limit true --dry-run
note: The fixture uses dry-run mode so CI never needs or prints an AMap key.
